parsed.notes: Lens A reviewed citation existence and quote/pin support only; treatment merits were not attacked.

reasons: The lake identity record is verified for Escobedo v. Illinois, U.S. Supreme Court, decided 1964-06-22, docket 615.
The official citation in the lake record is 378 U.S. 478, and content_page.md displays 378 U.S. 478 (1964).
The listed parallel and vendor citations match the disclosed lake citation fields.

defect.evidence_quote: We hold, therefore, that where, as here, the investigation is no longer a general inquiry into an unsolved crime but has begun to focus on a particular suspect, the suspect *491 has been taken into police custody
defect.locator_note: content_page.md cites ^pin-490 after the Rule quote; lake pinpoints[0] for pin-490 has page null, pinpoint_status slip-only, and quote_fidelity mismatch.
defect.problem: pin-490's stored pinpoint quote is not a quote from the Escobedo opinion passage. It is harvested page markdown/header/background text, while the actual 490-491 passage begins with the Court's holding paragraph.
defect.proposed_fix: Replace lake pinpoints[pin-490].quote with the actual holding paragraph from text/Escobedo v. Illinois__a3ccd8.txt at the 490-491 passage, and rebuild the page so the pin points to that source passage.

reasons: The disclosed lake pinpoint quote starts with page content, not opinion text: it includes the markdown title/header/background/issue material.
The cached opinion text contains the claimed holding passage at the 490-491 span, but that is not what lake pinpoints[pin-490].quote stores.
The content-page Rule quote is broadly supported by the opinion text, so the defect is the stored pin quote/pin metadata rather than the underlying holding.
residual_risks: Do not delete the Rule proposition as unsupported; correct the pinpoint quote and metadata.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Store the verified 490-491 holding paragraph as the pin quote and normalize the displayed quote against that source.

reasons: The treatment payload matches the disclosed lake treatment fields: field_i_validity caution, as_of_treatment 2026-06-30, varies_by_point true, and the same scope note.
Lens A records no substantive treatment/currency finding; that review belongs to Lens B.
residual_risks: Substantive good-law/treatment accuracy was not evaluated under Lens A.
